einzeiler: Collection of true horror and suspense stories from various contributors.
kurzfassung: This episode features a collection of listener-submitted true horror and suspense encounters. Stories include a prowler at a window, unsettling roommates, and dangerous ex-partners. Additional accounts cover strange experiences while traveling and unexpected confrontations.
stichpunkte: A prowler observed outside a window
A late-night cigarette break that potentially saved a life
An encounter involving a dad's roommate
The impact of an aunt's relationship with a difficult partner
Encounters experienced in the Amazon region
An observation from a front yard
A glass door being punched by an unknown person
Dealing with a clinically unstable ex-boyfriend
